verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec embedded in the reference page, a versioning policy, and an official MCP server. None of these is an official SDK. A REST API or spec is a building block a developer could use to generate a client, and MCP belongs to a separate story, so neither earns credit here. No official client libraries in any language are documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
